sql:
WITH high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name,
    s.nces_id,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served,
    s.low_grade_enrolled,
    s.high_grade_enrolled,
    s.status,
    s.grade12_enrollment
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.nces_district_id = '0613360'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.high_grade_enrolled = 12
    AND COALESCE(s.grade12_enrollment,0) > 0
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    SUM(sc.num_test_takers) AS total_sat_takers
  FROM satscores sc
  GROUP BY sc.school_id
),
eligible_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    hs.school_id,
    hs.name,
    hs.low_grade_served,
    hs.high_grade_served,
    hs.low_grade_enrolled,
    hs.high_grade_enrolled
  FROM high_schools hs
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts satc ON hs.school_id = satc.school_id
  WHERE COALESCE(satc.total_sat_takers, 0) = 0
),
ordered_grades AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) IN ('prekindergarten','pre-k','prek','preschool') THEN 0
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) = 'kindergarten' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) = 'k' THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 99 -- unknown or other grades far down
    END AS start_grade_order
  FROM eligible_high_schools
),
min_start_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_grade_order) AS min_order FROM ordered_grades
)
SELECT
  og.name AS school_name,
  og.low_grade_enrolled AS grade_span_start,
  og.high_grade_enrolled AS grade_span_end
FROM ordered_grades og, min_start_grade mg
WHERE og.start_grade_order = mg.min_order
ORDER BY og.name ASC;

WITH ca_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_code,
    s.school_name,
    s.k12enroll_1415,
    s.grdlo AS earliest_grade
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.state = 'CA'
    AND s.schtype = 'Special'
    AND s.schlevel = 'K-12'
    AND s.year = 2015
),
graded_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE earliest_grade
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0
      WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2
      WHEN '2' THEN 3
      WHEN '3' THEN 4
      WHEN '4' THEN 5
      WHEN '5' THEN 6
      WHEN '6' THEN 7
      WHEN '7' THEN 8
      WHEN '8' THEN 9
      WHEN '9' THEN 10
      WHEN '10' THEN 11
      WHEN '11' THEN 12
      WHEN '12' THEN 13
      ELSE 99
    END AS grade_rank
  FROM ca_special_schools
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    scode AS school_code,
    SUM(satnum) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  WHERE year = 2015
  GROUP BY scode
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.school_name,
    g.earliest_grade,
    g.k12enroll_1415,
    COALESCE(s.sat_test_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers,
    g.grade_rank
  FROM graded_ranked g
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON g.school_code = s.school_code
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  earliest_grade,
  k12enroll_1415,
  sat_test_takers
FROM joined
ORDER BY grade_rank DESC, k12enroll_1415 DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

If a state special school has no SAT record, still consider it a candidate and report it as having 0 SAT test takers. WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT county_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE cds_code = '1612590125716'
    LIMIT 1
),
eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.cds_code,
        s.county_name,
        s.school_name,
        f.charter_indicator,
        f.frpm_eligible,
        f.free_meals,
        f.enroll,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.enroll > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * f.free_meals / f.enroll, 2) 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS free_meal_pct,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.enroll > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * f.frpm_eligible / f.enroll, 2) 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.cds_code = s.cds_code
    WHERE 
        s.county_name = (SELECT county_name FROM target_county)
        AND f.school_type = 'K-12'
        AND f.free_meals > 500
        AND f.frpm_eligible < 700
),
charter_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator <> 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter
    FROM eligible_schools
),
sat_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.cds_code,
        (ss.sat_erw_avg_score + ss.sat_math_avg_score + ss.sat_essay_avg_score) AS sat_total
    FROM eligible_schools e
    JOIN satscores ss ON e.cds_code = ss.cds_code
    WHERE ss.sat_erw_avg_score IS NOT NULL 
      AND ss.sat_math_avg_score IS NOT NULL 
      AND ss.sat_essay_avg_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    es.county_name AS county_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT es.cds_code) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(es.free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(es.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    cc.num_charter,
    cc.num_non_charter,
    ROUND(AVG(sa.sat_total), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM eligible_schools es
LEFT JOIN charter_counts cc ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN sat_averages sa ON es.cds_code = sa.cds_code
GROUP BY es.county_name, cc.num_charter, cc.num_non_charter

WITH hs_full_12 AS (
  SELECT
    s.cdscode,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.charter_flag,
    fm.FreeMealCount,
    fm.Enrollment,
    CASE 
      WHEN fm.Enrollment > 0 THEN CAST(fm.FreeMealCount AS FLOAT) / fm.Enrollment
      ELSE NULL
    END AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm fm ON s.cdscode = fm.cdscode
  WHERE s.county = 'ALAMEDA'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
),
max_free_meal AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_rate
  FROM hs_full_12
  WHERE free_meal_rate IS NOT NULL
),
schools_with_max AS (
  SELECT 
    h.cdscode,
    h.school_name,
    ROUND(h.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN h.charter_flag = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      WHEN h.charter_flag = 0 THEN 'No'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS is_charter,
    h.GSserved
  FROM hs_full_12 h
  JOIN max_free_meal m ON h.free_meal_rate = m.max_rate
)
SELECT
  swm.school_name,
  swm.free_meal_rate,
  swm.is_charter,
  swm.GSserved AS grades_it_serves,

    WHEN ss.math_pct is NULL OR ss.erw_pct is NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'

      CASE 
        WHEN (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 < 33 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 >= 33 AND (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 < 67 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
      END

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    school_id,
    school_name,
    county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE is_exclusively_virtual = 1
),
virtual_school_county_counts AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_virtual_schools
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
  GROUP BY county_name
),
county_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    num_virtual_schools,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC) AS rank
  FROM virtual_school_county_counts
),
fifth_highest_count AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(num_virtual_schools) AS num_virtual_schools
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT num_virtual_schools
    FROM county_ranks
    ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC
    LIMIT 5
  )
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT
    c.county_name,
    c.num_virtual_schools
  FROM county_ranks c
  JOIN fifth_highest_count f
    ON c.num_virtual_schools >= f.num_virtual_schools
),
county_school_sat AS (
  SELECT
    evs.county_name,
    evs.school_id,
    evs.school_name,
    s.avg_reading_score
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
  LEFT JOIN satscores s
    ON evs.school_id = s.school_id
),
county_max_sat AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    MAX(avg_reading_score) AS max_avg_reading_score
  FROM county_school_sat
  GROUP BY county_name
),
best_schools_per_county AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    t.county_name,
    t.num_virtual_schools,
    CASE
      WHEN cms.max_avg_reading_score IS NULL THEN 'None'
      WHEN cs.avg_reading_score = cms.max_avg_reading_score THEN cs.school_name
      ELSE NULL
    END AS school_name
  FROM top_counties t

  WHERE cs.avg_reading_score = cms.max_avg_reading_score

)
SELECT
  county_name,
  num_virtual_schools,
  school_name
FROM best_schools_per_county
WHERE school_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC, county_name, school_name

    s.MailingCity,
    s.MailingState,
    s.MailingZip,
    s.Website,

    s.OpenDate,
    s.CloseDate

    AND s.CharterYN = 'N'
    AND s.SchoolType = 'Regular'
    AND s.CDSCode IS NOT NULL
),
frpm_share AS (
  SELECT
    es.*,
    CAST(frpm.FRPM_Eligible AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(es.K12Enrollment,0) AS FRPM_Share
  FROM eligible_schools es
  LEFT JOIN frpm frpm ON es.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
),
sat AS (
  SELECT
    sa.CDSCode,
    COUNT(*) AS SAT_Takers,
    AVG(sa.CriticalReading + sa.Math + sa.Writing) AS Avg_SAT_Total,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (sa.CriticalReading + sa.Math + sa.Writing) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS Pct_1500plus
  FROM satscores sa
  GROUP BY sa.CDSCode
),
school_status AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE WHEN CloseDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS School_Status
  FROM frpm_share
),
with_sat AS (
  SELECT
    ss.*,
    sat.Avg_SAT_Total,
    sat.Pct_1500plus
  FROM school_status ss
  LEFT JOIN sat ON ss.CDSCode = sat.CDSCode
),
largest_frpm_count AS (
  SELECT
    *, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS which_extreme
  FROM with_sat
  WHERE FRPM_Eligible = (SELECT MAX(FRPM_Eligible) FROM with_sat)
),
smallest_frpm_share AS (

WITH target_school AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM schools
  WHERE cds = '1611430131177'
),
county_schools AS (
  SELECT s.cds, s.admin_fnm, s.admin_lnm
  FROM schools s, target_school t
  WHERE substr(s.cds, 1, 2) = substr(t.cds, 1, 2) -- county code is first 2 digits of CDS
    AND s.dist_type NOT IN ('X', 'D') -- Exclude district/county office entries (school-level only)
),
school_scores AS (
  SELECT sa.cds, SUM(sa.num_taken * (sa.tot_1500_1600 * 1.0 / NULLIF(sa.num_taken,0))) AS num_1500plus
  FROM satscores sa
  INNER JOIN county_schools cs ON sa.cds = cs.cds
  WHERE sa.tot_1500_1600 IS NOT NULL AND sa.num_taken IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sa.cds
)
SELECT s.admin_fnm, s.admin_lnm
FROM county_schools s
JOIN school_scores sc ON s.cds = sc.cds
WHERE sc.num_1500plus = (
    SELECT MAX(num_1500plus)
    FROM school_scores
)
ORDER BY s.cds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH set_translation_counts AS (
    SELECT
        set_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS translation_count
    FROM set_translations
    GROUP BY set_code
),
sets_with_few_translations AS (
    SELECT
        s.code
    FROM sets s
    JOIN set_translation_counts stc ON s.code = stc.set_code
    WHERE stc.translation_count < 5
),
cards_in_few_translation_sets AS (
    SELECT
        c.set_code,
        COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.set_code IN (SELECT code FROM sets_with_few_translations)
    GROUP BY c.set_code
)
SELECT
    SUM(card_count) AS total_cards
FROM cards_in_few_translation_sets;

WITH sets_with_translations AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.set_type
  FROM sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.set_code
  WHERE st.official = 1
),
cards_in_translated_sets AS (
  SELECT s.set_type, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards c
  INNER JOIN sets_with_translations s ON c.set_code = s.code
  GROUP BY s.set_type
),
translated_sets_count AS (
  SELECT set_type, COUNT(*) AS sets_with_translations
  FROM sets_with_translations
  GROUP BY set_type
)
SELECT
  s.set_type,
  COALESCE(t.sets_with_translations, 0) AS sets_with_translations,
  COALESCE(c.card_count, 0) AS cards_in_translated_sets
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT set_type FROM sets) s
  LEFT JOIN translated_sets_count t ON s.set_type = t.set_type
  LEFT JOIN cards_in_translated_sets c ON s.set_type = c.set_type
ORDER BY
  s.set_type ASC;

WITH
-- Find the set code of the first Abyssal Horror printing
abyssal_horror_first_print AS (
  SELECT c.set_code, s.release_date
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
  AND c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND s.release_date = (
    SELECT MIN(ss.release_date)
    FROM cards cc
    JOIN sets ss ON cc.set_code = ss.code
    WHERE cc.name = 'Abyssal Horror' AND cc.mana_cost IS NOT NULL
  )
  ORDER BY s.release_date ASC, c.set_code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Find the set code of the most recently released set
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code AS set_code, release_date
  FROM sets
  WHERE release_date = (SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
sets_of_interest AS (
  SELECT set_code, release_date FROM abyssal_horror_first_print
  UNION ALL
  SELECT set_code, release_date FROM most_recent_set
),
-- For each set of interest, calculate the stats
set_card_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.set_name,
    s.code AS set_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_with_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND c.mana_value <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cheap_count
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE s.code IN (SELECT set_code FROM sets_of_interest)
  GROUP BY s.code, s.set_name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(cheap_count AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_with_cost, 0), 2
  ) AS percent_cards_CMC_3_or_less
FROM set_card_stats;

WITH commander_cards AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.frame, c.foil, c.cardkingdom_foil_id, c.cardkingdom_id
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.legalities_commander = 'legal'
    AND c.cardkingdom_id IS NOT NULL
),
both_printings AS (
  SELECT id, frame
  FROM commander_cards
  GROUP BY id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cardkingdom_foil_id IS NOT NULL AND foil = 1 THEN 'foil' END) >= 1
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cardkingdom_id IS NOT NULL AND (foil IS NULL OR foil = 0) THEN 'nonfoil' END) >= 1
),
frames_with_year AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(frame AS INTEGER) AS frame_year
  FROM both_printings
  WHERE frame GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(frame_year) AS latest_frame_year
  FROM frames_with_year
)
SELECT
  l.latest_frame_year AS frame_year,
  COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM both_printings b
JOIN latest_year l
  ON CAST(b.frame AS INTEGER) = l.latest_frame_year
GROUP BY l.latest_frame_year
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH commander_2020_sets AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.released_at
  FROM sets s
  WHERE
    s.type = 'commander'
    AND s.released_at BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
),
set_card_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.set_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_card_count
  FROM cards c
  INNER JOIN commander_2020_sets s ON c.set_id = s.id
  WHERE
    (c.collector_number NOT LIKE 'A%')  -- Exclude Alchemy modifications, which often have 'A'-prefixes (if schema uses it)
  GROUP BY c.set_id
),
set_languages AS (
  SELECT
    st.set_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS languages_count
  FROM set_translations st
  GROUP BY st.set_id
),
full_data AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    cc.total_card_count,
    COALESCE(sl.languages_count, 0) AS languages_count
  FROM commander_2020_sets s
  INNER JOIN set_card_counts cc ON s.id = cc.set_id
  LEFT JOIN set_languages sl ON s.id = sl.set_id
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_card_count) AS max_card_count FROM full_data
)
SELECT
  fd.id,
  fd.name,
  fd.total_card_count,
  fd.languages_count
FROM full_data fd
CROSS JOIN max_count mc
WHERE fd.total_card_count = mc.max_card_count
ORDER BY fd.id ASC;

For the 2008/2009 season and the 2015/2016 season of the Italian league, I'd like to know how many players appeared in matches that season (i.e. were listed in a match's lineup, including players who appeared in both seasons), and the average height of those players in centimeters, rounded to two decimals. One row per season with the season label, the count of players, and their average height.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH serie_a_ids AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM League
  WHERE name = 'Italy Serie A'
),
seasons AS (
  SELECT '2008/2009' AS season_label, '2008-08-01' AS start_date, '2009-07-31' AS end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2015/2016', '2015-08-01', '2016-07-31'
),
season_matches AS (
  SELECT s.season_label, m.id AS match_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN serie_a_ids l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN seasons s
    ON m.date >= s.start_date AND m.date <= s.end_date
),
match_players AS (
  SELECT
    sm.season_label,
    mp
  FROM season_matches sm
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           home_player_1 AS p1, home_player_2 AS p2, home_player_3 AS p3, home_player_4 AS p4, home_player_5 AS p5,
           home_player_6 AS p6, home_player_7 AS p7, home_player_8 AS p8, home_player_9 AS p9, home_player_10 AS p10,
           home_player_11 AS p11, 
           away_player_1 AS p12, away_player_2 AS p13, away_player_3 AS p14, away_player_4 AS p15, away_player_5 AS p16,
           away_player_6 AS p17, away_player_7 AS p18, away_player_8 AS p19, away_player_9 AS p20, away_player_10 AS p21,
           away_player_11 AS p22
    FROM Match
  ) unpivoted
  ON sm.match_id = unpivoted.match_id
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 1 idx UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5
    UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11
    UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16
    UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22
  ) c
  JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS idx, 'p1' AS col UNION SELECT 2, 'p2' UNION SELECT 3, 'p3' UNION SELECT 4, 'p4' UNION SELECT 5, 'p5'
    UNION SELECT 6, 'p6' UNION SELECT 7, 'p7' UNION SELECT 8, 'p8' UNION SELECT 9, 'p9' UNION SELECT 10, 'p10'
    UNION SELECT 11, 'p11' UNION SELECT 12, 'p12' UNION SELECT 13, 'p13' UNION SELECT 14, 'p14' UNION SELECT 15, 'p15'
    UNION SELECT 16, 'p16' UNION SELECT 17, 'p17' UNION SELECT 18, 'p18' UNION SELECT 19, 'p19' UNION SELECT 20, 'p20'
    UNION SELECT 21, 'p21' UNION SELECT 22, 'p22'
  ) idxmap ON c.idx = idxmap.idx
  LEFT JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = 
    CASE idxmap.col
      WHEN 'p1' THEN unpivoted.p1 WHEN 'p2' THEN unpivoted.p2 WHEN 'p3' THEN unpivoted.p3
      WHEN 'p4' THEN unpivoted.p4 WHEN 'p5' THEN unpivoted.p5 WHEN 'p6' THEN unpivoted.p6
      WHEN 'p7' THEN unpivoted.p7 WHEN 'p8' THEN unpivoted.p8 WHEN 'p9' THEN unpivoted.p9
      WHEN 'p10' THEN unpivoted.p10 WHEN 'p11' THEN unpivoted.p11
      WHEN 'p12' THEN unpivoted.p12 WHEN 'p13' THEN unpivoted.p13 WHEN 'p14' THEN unpivoted.p14
      WHEN 'p15' THEN unpivoted.p15 WHEN 'p16' THEN unpivoted.p16 WHEN 'p17' THEN unpivoted.p17
      WHEN 'p18' THEN unpivoted.p18 WHEN 'p19' THEN unpivoted.p19 WHEN 'p20' THEN unpivoted.p20
      WHEN 'p21' THEN unpivoted.p21 WHEN 'p22' THEN unpivoted.p22
    END
  WHERE 
    CASE idxmap.col
      WHEN 'p1' THEN unpivoted.p1 WHEN 'p2' THEN unpivoted.p2 WHEN 'p3' THEN unpivoted.p3
      WHEN 'p4' THEN unpivoted.p4 WHEN 'p5' THEN unpivoted.p5 WHEN 'p6' THEN unpivoted.p6
      WHEN 'p7' THEN unpivoted.p7 WHEN 'p8' THEN unpivoted.p8 WHEN 'p9' THEN unpivoted.p9
      WHEN 'p10' THEN unpivoted.p10 WHEN 'p11' THEN unpivoted.p11
      WHEN 'p12' THEN unpivoted.p12 WHEN 'p13' THEN unpivoted.p13 WHEN 'p14' THEN unpivoted.p14
      WHEN 'p15' THEN unpivoted.p15 WHEN 'p16' THEN unpivoted.p16 WHEN 'p17' THEN unpivoted.p17
      WHEN 'p18' THEN unpivoted.p18 WHEN 'p19' THEN unpivoted.p19 WHEN 'p20' THEN unpivoted.p20
      WHEN 'p21' THEN unpivoted.p21 WHEN 'p22' THEN unpivoted.p22
    END IS NOT NULL
),
players_per_season AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    season_label,
    mp AS player_api_id
  FROM match_players
  WHERE mp IS NOT NULL
),
final_heights AS (
  SELECT
    pps.season_label,
    pps.player_api_id,
    pl.height
  FROM players_per_season pps
  JOIN Player pl ON pps.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
  WHERE pl.height IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  season_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count,
  ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM final_heights
GROUP BY season_label
ORDER BY season_label;
```

WITH Latest_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.id,
    pa.date,
    pa.volleys,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM Player p
JOIN Latest_Attributes la
  ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND la.volleys > 70

WITH LowWeightPlayers AS (

    pl.player_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Home players

    pl.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,

    )
  )
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
  WHERE pa.weight <= 160
)
, PlayerInCountry AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_id,
    c.name AS country_name,
    pl.player_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Home/away players
  UNPIVOT (
    player_api_id FOR player_role IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
      m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
      m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
  )
)
, CountryLowWeightCounts AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS country_id,
    c.name AS country_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN pa.weight <= 160 THEN p.player_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS low_weight_player_count
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Collect all home player ids
  LEFT JOIN Player p
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,

      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
  LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country_name, low_weight_player_count
FROM CountryLowWeightCounts
WHERE low_weight_player_count = (
  SELECT MIN(low_weight_player_count)
  FROM CountryLowWeightCounts

If several countries tie for the fewest, give me every tied country's name. Include all seasons in the database, and count the players who took part in those matches.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH LowWeightPlayers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.match_api_id,
    pl.player_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Home players
  LEFT JOIN Player pl ON (
    pl.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
      m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
  )
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
  WHERE pa.weight <= 160
)
, PlayerInCountry AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_id,
    c.name AS country_name,
    pl.player_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Home/away players
  UNPIVOT (
    player_api_id FOR player_role IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
      m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
      m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
  )
)
, CountryLowWeightCounts AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS country_id,
    c.name AS country_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN pa.weight <= 160 THEN p.player_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS low_weight_player_count
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
  -- Collect all home player ids
  LEFT JOIN Player p
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
      m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
  LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country_name, low_weight_player_count
FROM CountryLowWeightCounts
WHERE low_weight_player_count = (
  SELECT MIN(low_weight_player_count)
  FROM CountryLowWeightCounts
)
```

WITH latest_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
)

  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN la.attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 END)
    /
    COUNT(*)
  , 1) AS percent_low_attacking_work_rate
FROM latest_attributes la
JOIN Player p ON la.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND p.preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND la.attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DATE('2013-07-12') AS dt
),
ld_id AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
),
player_ratings_on_date AS (
  -- For each player, get their most recent record ON OR BEFORE 2013-07-12
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      player_api_id,
      MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= (SELECT dt FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) latest
    ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
ld_rating AS (
  SELECT overall_rating
  FROM player_ratings_on_date
  WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM ld_id)
),
avg_rating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
  FROM player_ratings_on_date
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    ((SELECT overall_rating FROM ld_rating) - (SELECT avg_overall FROM avg_rating)) 
     / (SELECT avg_overall FROM avg_rating) * 100.0, 2
  ) AS percentage_higher

Return one value only: that percentage, rounded to two decimals (e.g. 12.34 meaning 12.34% higher).

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DATE('2013-07-12') AS dt
),
ld_id AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
),
player_ratings_on_date AS (
  -- For each player, get their most recent record ON OR BEFORE 2013-07-12
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      player_api_id,
      MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= (SELECT dt FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) latest
    ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
ld_rating AS (
  SELECT overall_rating
  FROM player_ratings_on_date
  WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM ld_id)
),
avg_rating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
  FROM player_ratings_on_date
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    ((SELECT overall_rating FROM ld_rating) - (SELECT avg_overall FROM avg_rating)) 
     / (SELECT avg_overall FROM avg_rating) * 100.0, 2
  ) AS percentage_higher
```

WITH loan_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'B' -- running in debt
),
districts_with_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
    FROM district d
    JOIN loan_accounts la ON d.district_id = la.district_id
),
unemployment_95_96 AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A11 AS unemployment_95, d.A12 AS unemployment_96
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A11 IS NOT NULL AND d.A12 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    u.district_name AS district,
    ROUND(
        CASE WHEN u.unemployment_95 = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE 100.0 * (u.unemployment_96 - u.unemployment_95) / u.unemployment_95
        END, 2
    ) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM unemployment_95_96 u
JOIN districts_with_loans d ON u.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY unemployment_rate_pct_change DESC

WITH loan_status AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    l.appl_date,
    l.duration,
    d.A2 AS region_name,
    DATE(l.appl_date, printf('+%d months', l.duration)) AS end_date
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE l.appl_date <= '1995-12-31'
    AND DATE(l.appl_date, printf('+%d months', l.duration)) >= '1995-12-31'
)
, region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    region_name,
    SUM(amount) AS total_approved
  FROM loan_status
  GROUP BY region_name
)
, max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_approved) AS max_approved FROM region_totals
)
SELECT
  r.region_name,
  r.total_approved
FROM region_totals r
JOIN max_total m ON r.total_approved = m.max_approved
ORDER BY r.region_name;

WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
      AND birth_number BETWEEN 740101 AND 769231
),
customer_accounts AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id
    FROM disp

),

        CASE
            WHEN purpose = 'household payment' THEN 'household'
            WHEN purpose IS NOT NULL AND purpose <> 'household payment' THEN 'other'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS category
    FROM large_payments
)
SELECT
    SUM(category = 'household') AS household_payment_count,
    SUM(category = 'other') AS other_purpose_payment_count
FROM categorized_payments
WHERE category IS NOT NULL;

first_request.user:
I'm putting together a periodic report on large payments made by a specific customer cohort, split by what the payment was for. Among payments over $4000 (strictly more than $4000) made from the accounts of male customers born between 1974 and 1976, I need two figures: how many were household payments, and how many were made for a purpose other than household payment. A few rules to keep in mind: born between 1974 and 1976 means the birth year is 1974, 1975 or 1976; a customer's accounts are the ones they hold a disposition on; payments are the individual transactions executed on the account, not standing payment orders; a payment counts as other-purpose only if it has a recorded purpose different from household payment, and a payment with no purpose recorded counts in neither bucket.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

answer:
```sql
WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
      AND birth_number BETWEEN 740101 AND 769231
),
customer_accounts AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN male_customers_74_76 mc ON disp.client_id = mc.client_id
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.type, t.operation, t.purpose
    FROM trans t
    JOIN customer_accounts ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.amount > 4000
      AND t.type = 'debit'
),
categorized_payments AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN purpose = 'household payment' THEN 'household'
            WHEN purpose IS NOT NULL AND purpose <> 'household payment' THEN 'other'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS category
    FROM large_payments
)
SELECT
    SUM(category = 'household') AS household_payment_count,
    SUM(category = 'other') AS other_purpose_payment_count
FROM categorized_payments
WHERE category IS NOT NULL;
```

WITH prachatice_branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS branch_district_id, a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT la.account_id
    FROM loan la
    JOIN prachatice_branch_accounts pba ON la.account_id = pba.account_id
),
account_owners AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_home_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.account_id,
        pba.account_open_date,
        ao.client_id AS owner_client_id,
        ao.home_district_id
    FROM borrowing_accounts ba
    JOIN prachatice_branch_accounts pba ON ba.account_id = pba.account_id
    JOIN account_owners ao ON ba.account_id = ao.account_id
),
district_populations AS (
    SELECT district_id, A3 AS district_name, A4 AS region, A2 AS district_town, A5 AS population
    FROM district
),
total_loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
outside_counterparties AS (
    -- Only trans with type 'PRIJEM' (incoming transfer) or 'VYDAJ' (outgoing transfer) that are not cash (karta, vyber, vklad)
    SELECT 
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_account) AS num_outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
      AND t.operation NOT IN ('VYBER', 'VKLAD', 'VYBER KARTOU', 'POKLADNA') -- exclude cash operations
      AND t.bank = 'czech' -- only bank transfers (assume only non-cash ops in these types)
      AND t.bank_account IS NOT NULL
      AND LENGTH(t.bank_account) > 0
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ahd.account_id,
        ahd.account_open_date,
        IFNULL(tla.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
        IFNULL(oc.num_outside_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_counterparties,
        ahd.home_district_id,
        dp.district_town AS home_district_name,
        dp.population AS home_district_population
    FROM account_home_districts ahd
    LEFT JOIN district_populations dp ON ahd.home_district_id = dp.district_id
    LEFT JOIN total_loan_amounts tla ON ahd.account_id = tla.account_id
    LEFT JOIN outside_counterparties oc ON ahd.account_id = oc.account_id
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    account_open_date,
    total_borrowed,
    num_outside_counterparties,
    home_district_name,
    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC
    ) AS home_district_population_rank
FROM final_ranked
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC;

WITH gold_cards AS (
  SELECT c.card_id, c.disp_id, d.account_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
account_avg_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
qualified_accounts AS (
  SELECT gc.card_id, gc.disp_id, gc.account_id
  FROM gold_cards gc
  JOIN account_avg_balance aab ON gc.account_id = aab.account_id
  WHERE aab.avg_balance > 1000
),
joined_info AS (
  SELECT
    d.disp_id,
    d.client_id,
    acc.account_id,
    acc.district_id AS acc_district_id
  FROM qualified_accounts acc
  JOIN disp d ON acc.account_id = d.account_id
),
client_info AS (
  SELECT 
    ji.*,
    cl.gender
  FROM joined_info ji
  JOIN client cl ON ji.client_id = cl.client_id
),
districts_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    a.district_id AS acc_district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN client_info c ON a.account_id = c.account_id
  JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
  WHERE di.inhabitants > 100000
  GROUP BY c.gender, a.district_id
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    di.district_id,
    di.inhabitants,
    di.avg_salary,
    di.urban_ratio
  FROM district di
),
final_districts AS (
  SELECT
    df.gender,
    ds.district_id,
    ds.inhabitants,
    ds.avg_salary,
    ds.urban_ratio
  FROM districts_filtered df
  JOIN district_stats ds ON df.acc_district_id = ds.district_id
),
per_gender_stats AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM final_districts
  GROUP BY gender
),
max_inhab_districts AS (
  SELECT
    f.gender,
    f.district_id,
    f.inhabitants
  FROM final_districts f
  JOIN per_gender_stats s
    ON f.gender = s.gender AND f.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
)
SELECT
  s.gender,
  s.district_count,
  m.district_id AS max_inhab_district_id,
  m.inhabitants AS max_inhabitants,
  s.avg_salary,
  s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender_stats s
JOIN max_inhab_districts m ON s.gender = m.gender
WHERE s.gender IN ('F', 'M')
ORDER BY s.gender, m.district_id
;

WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.district_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    d.avg_salary,
    d.unemployment_rate_95,
    d.unemployment_rate_96,
    d.no_of_inhabitants
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_credit_card AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, dp.client_id
  FROM disp dp
  JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
),
clients_with_loan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, dp.client_id
  FROM disp dp
  JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
),
qualified_clients AS (
  SELECT fc.*, fc.region
  FROM female_clients fc
  JOIN clients_with_credit_card cc ON fc.client_id = cc.client_id
  JOIN clients_with_loan cl ON fc.client_id = cl.client_id
  WHERE cc.account_id = cl.account_id
)
, districts_per_region AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    district_name,
    avg_salary,
    unemployment_rate_96,
    no_of_inhabitants
  FROM district
)
, region_district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    qc.region,
    qc.district_id,
    qc.district_name,
    avg(qc.avg_salary) AS avg_salary,
    avg(qc.unemployment_rate_96) AS unemployment_rate_96
  FROM qualified_clients qc
  GROUP BY qc.region, qc.district_id, qc.district_name
)
, most_populous_districts AS (
  SELECT
    r.region,
    d.district_name,
    d.no_of_inhabitants,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.region
      ORDER BY d.no_of_inhabitants DESC, d.district_name ASC
    ) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT region, district_id
    FROM qualified_clients
  ) r
  JOIN district d ON r.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
  qs.region,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.avg_salary),2) AS avg_district_salary,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.unemployment_rate_96),2) AS avg_district_unemployment_rate_96,
  mpd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM region_district_stats qs
JOIN (
  SELECT region, district_name
  FROM most_populous_districts
  WHERE rn = 1
) mpd ON qs.region = mpd.region
GROUP BY qs.region, mpd.district_name
ORDER BY qs.region

WITH litomerice_region AS (
    SELECT region 
    FROM district 
    WHERE district_name = 'Litomerice'
    LIMIT 1
),
districts_in_region AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name
    FROM district
    WHERE region = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_opened_1996 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.district_name
    FROM account a
    JOIN districts_in_region d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'
),
last_trans_1996 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           MAX(t.date) AS last_date_1996
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_opened_1996)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
last_trans_ids AS (
    -- For accounts with multiple transactions on the last date, pick max trans_id.
    SELECT t.account_id,
           t.trans_id,
           t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN last_trans_1996 l
      ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date = l.last_date_1996
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_opened_1996)
    AND t.trans_id = (
        SELECT MAX(trans_id)
        FROM trans
        WHERE account_id = t.account_id
          AND date = t.date
    )
),
accounts_with_balance AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.district_id,
           a.district_name,
           COALESCE(t.balance, 0) AS end_1996_balance
    FROM accounts_opened_1996 a
    LEFT JOIN last_trans_ids t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
)
SELECT
    dists.district_name,
    dists.accounts_opened,
    ROUND(dists.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
    reg.avg_balance_region,
    reg.max_avg_district
FROM (
    -- Per district numbers
    SELECT
        d.district_name,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS accounts_opened,

WITH district_pop AS (
    SELECT district.district_id, district.name AS district_name, district.region, district.A2 AS inhabitants
    FROM district
    WHERE district.A2 >= 100000
),
account_district AS (
    SELECT account.account_id, account.district_id
    FROM account
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.district_id, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account_district ad
    JOIN trans t ON ad.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
),
district_with_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT dp.*, w.total_withdrawn
    FROM district_pop dp
    JOIN withdrawals w ON dp.district_id = w.district_id
    WHERE w.total_withdrawn > 0
),
withdrawals_per_inhabitant AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*, 
        ROUND(d.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / d.inhabitants, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant
    FROM district_with_withdrawals d
),
withdrawals_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        *, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank
    FROM withdrawals_per_inhabitant
),
accounts_per_district AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
so_debits_per_district AS (
    SELECT 
        a.district_id,
        IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.type = 'debit' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_so_debits
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
        AND o.type = 'debit'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
so_per_account AS (
    SELECT
        apd.district_id,
        ROUND(
            spd.total_so_debits * 1.0 / apd.num_accounts
        , 2) AS avg_so_debit_per_account
    FROM accounts_per_district apd
    LEFT JOIN so_debits_per_district spd ON apd.district_id = spd.district_id
)
SELECT
    wr.district_name,
    wr.region,
    wr.inhabitants AS population,
    ROUND(wr.total_withdrawn, 2) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    wr.withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    wr.withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank,
    spa.avg_so_debit_per_account
FROM withdrawals_ranked wr
LEFT JOIN so_per_account spa ON wr.district_id = spa.district_id
ORDER BY wr.withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank, wr.district_name
;

  GROUP BY ar.account_id
),
yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    open_year AS year,

    SUM(total_loan) AS total_lent
  FROM accounts_loans
  GROUP BY open_year
),
district_yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    open_year AS year,
    district_id,
    COUNT(account_id) AS district_accounts,
    SUM(total_loan) AS district_total_lent,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(account_id) = 0 THEN 0

  FROM accounts_loans
  GROUP BY open_year, district_id
)

  ys.year,

For accounts opened in the central Bohemia region from 1 January 1996 onward, broken down by the calendar year of the account creation date (as a text string like '1996', not an integer), I need: the number of accounts opened that year in the region, the total amount lent on those accounts, and the average across the districts of the amount lent per account opened in that district, rounded to two decimals. An account with no loan counts as having lent nothing.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

answer:
```sql
WITH accounts_region AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    strftime('%Y', a.date) AS open_year,
    d.district_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.region = 'central Bohemia'
    AND date(a.date) >= '1996-01-01'
),
accounts_loans AS (
  SELECT
    ar.account_id,
    ar.open_year,
    ar.district_id,
    ar.district_name,
    ar.region,
    IFNULL(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan
  FROM accounts_region ar
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON ar.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY ar.account_id
),
yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    open_year AS year,
    COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts,
    SUM(total_loan) AS total_lent
  FROM accounts_loans
  GROUP BY open_year
),
district_yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    open_year AS year,
    district_id,
    COUNT(account_id) AS district_accounts,
    SUM(total_loan) AS district_total_lent,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(account_id) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE SUM(total_loan) * 1.0 / COUNT(account_id)
    END AS lent_per_account
  FROM accounts_loans
  GROUP BY open_year, district_id
)
SELECT
  ys.year,
  ys.num_accounts,
  ys.total_lent,
  ROUND(AVG(dys.lent_per_account), 2) AS avg_lent_per_account_by_district
FROM yearly_stats ys
JOIN district_yearly_stats dys ON ys.year = dys.year
GROUP BY ys.year, ys.num_accounts, ys.total_lent
ORDER BY ys.year;
```

WITH weekly_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.frequency = 'WEEKLY'
),
loans_24m AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date AS approval_date
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.duration = 24
),
filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.approval_date
    FROM loans_24m l
    INNER JOIN weekly_accounts wa ON l.account_id = wa.account_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        fl.loan_id,
        fl.account_id,
        wa.district_id,
        fl.amount,
        fl.approval_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY fl.amount DESC, fl.approval_date ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM filtered_loans fl
    INNER JOIN weekly_accounts wa ON fl.account_id = wa.account_id
),
loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        rl.loan_id,
        rl.account_id,
        rl.district_id,
        rl.amount,
        rl.approval_date,
        (
            SELECT t.balance
            FROM trans t
            WHERE t.account_id = rl.account_id
              AND t.date = rl.approval_date
            ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS balance_on_approval_date
    FROM ranked_loans rl
    WHERE rl.rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    lb.district_id AS branch_district,
    lb.amount AS approved_amount,
    lb.approval_date,
    lb.balance_on_approval_date
FROM loan_balances lb
ORDER BY lb.amount DESC, lb.approval_date ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_number,
           CASE 
               WHEN SUBSTR(printf('%06d', c.birth_number), 3, 2) > '50' THEN 'F'
               ELSE 'M'
           END AS gender
    FROM client c
    WHERE SUBSTR(printf('%06d', c.birth_number), 3, 2) > '50'
),
loan_females AS (
    SELECT l.*, a.account_id, fc.client_id, fc.birth_number
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN female_clients fc ON d.client_id = fc.client_id
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM loan_females
    WHERE amount IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT amount
        FROM loan_females
        WHERE status = 'A'
        ORDER BY amount DESC
        LIMIT 3
    )
),
loan_transactions AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_deposits
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
account_district_region AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.district_name, d.region, d.avg_salary
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT d.region, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS region_loans
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
region_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(avg_salary),2) AS avg_of_avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY region
),
enriched_loans AS (
    SELECT
        tl.loan_id,
        tl.client_id,
        tl.amount,
        tl.duration,
        ROUND(tl.duration * tl.payments,2) AS total_payments,
        ROUND((tl.duration * tl.payments) - tl.amount,2) AS interest_paid,
        tl.status,
        adr.district_name,
        adr.region,
        adr.avg_salary,
        lt.transaction_count,
        ROUND(lt.total_deposits,2) AS total_deposits,
        CASE
            WHEN lt.total_deposits > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
            WHEN lt.total_deposits > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
            ELSE 'Low Income'
        END AS income_category,
        rlc.region_loans,
        rsa.avg_of_avg_salary,
        tl.birth_number,
        tl.account_id
    FROM top_loans tl
    JOIN account_district_region adr ON tl.account_id = adr.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_transactions lt ON tl.account_id = lt.account_id
    LEFT JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON adr.region = rlc.region
    LEFT JOIN region_avg_salary rsa ON adr.region = rsa.region
)
SELECT
    el.client_id,
    el.amount,
    el.duration,
    el.total_payments,
    el.interest_paid,
    el.status AS loan_status,
    el.district_name AS branch_district,
    el.region AS branch_region,
    el.transaction_count,
    el.total_deposits,
    el.income_category,
    el.region_loans,
    el.avg_of_avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    -- Calculate completed age on 2026-10-09
    -- birth_number: YYMMDD, if MM>50 => female. If MM>50, true month = MM-50. Year: if YY<26 then 2000+YY else 1900+YY
    ( 
        -- calc birthdate
        WITH b AS (
            SELECT
                el.birth_number,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),1,2) AS INTEGER) AS yy,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),3,2) AS INTEGER) AS mm_raw,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),5,2) AS INTEGER) AS dd
        )
        SELECT
            ( 
                (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)
                +
                (CASE 
                    WHEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 
                      AND (
                            ( (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 )
                            AND (
                                ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )<10 )
                                OR ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )=10 AND dd <= 9 )
                            )
                         )
                    THEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END))
                    ELSE (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) -1
                END)
            )
        FROM b
    ) AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM enriched_loans el
ORDER BY el.amount DESC
;

        ROUND((tl.duration * tl.payments) - tl.amount,2) AS interest_paid,
        tl.status,
        adr.district_name,
        adr.region,
        adr.avg_salary,

        ROUND(lt.total_deposits,2) AS total_deposits,

            WHEN lt.total_deposits > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
            ELSE 'Low Income'
        END AS income_category,
        rlc.region_loans,
        rsa.avg_of_avg_salary,
        tl.birth_number,
        tl.account_id
    FROM top_loans tl
    JOIN account_district_region adr ON tl.account_id = adr.account_id

    el.transaction_count,
    el.total_deposits,
    el.income_category,
    el.region_loans,
    el.avg_of_avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    -- Calculate completed age on 2026-10-09
    -- birth_number: YYMMDD, if MM>50 => female. If MM>50, true month = MM-50. Year: if YY<26 then 2000+YY else 1900+YY
    ( 
        -- calc birthdate
        WITH b AS (
            SELECT
                el.birth_number,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),1,2) AS INTEGER) AS yy,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),3,2) AS INTEGER) AS mm_raw,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),5,2) AS INTEGER) AS dd
        )
        SELECT
            ( 
                (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)
                +
                (CASE 
                    WHEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 
                      AND (
                            ( (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 )
                            AND (
                                ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )<10 )
                                OR ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )=10 AND dd <= 9 )
                            )
                         )
                    THEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END))
                    ELSE (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) -1
                END)
            )
        FROM b
    ) AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM enriched_loans el
ORDER BY el.amount DESC
;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id

        d.region AS branch_region

),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
transfers AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        -- Unique COUNT for external accounts where account_id != k_symbol (ignoring blanks and own account)
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != '' 
                 AND (t.account_id != t.account)
                 THEN t.account
            ELSE NULL END
        ) AS num_external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
    ad.account_id,
    ad.district_name,
    ad.branch_region,
    COALESCE(tr.total_received,0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(tr.total_withdrawn,0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(al.loan_count, 0) AS num_loans_taken,
    COALESCE(tr.num_external_counterparties, 0) AS num_accounts_external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(tr.num_external_counterparties,0) DESC) AS external_counterparty_rank
FROM account_district ad
LEFT JOIN transfers tr ON ad.account_id = tr.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_loans al ON ad.account_id = al.account_id
ORDER BY external_counterparty_rank, ad.account_id

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.name = 'Tabor'
),
owners AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, c.gender, 
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_number, 'unixepoch') 
                - (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_number, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS age_1996
    FROM disp
    JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards_up_to_1996 AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_cards
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
    WHERE card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY disp.account_id
),
loans_up_to_1996 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_defaulted,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_repaying,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_paid
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_standing AS (
    SELECT account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN n_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN any_defaulted > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN any_repaying > 0 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing_label
    FROM loans_up_to_1996
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        COUNT(*) AS n_trans
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
balance_series AS (
    -- Compute the running account balance; for each account and transaction, accumulate up to the date of each transaction in 1997
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
),
peak_balances AS (
    SELECT account_id, COALESCE(MAX(balance),0) AS peak_balance
    FROM balance_series
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked_balances AS (
    SELECT account_id, peak_balance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC) AS balance_rank
    FROM peak_balances
)
SELECT
    ta.account_id,
    ta.account_open_date,
    o.gender,
    o.age_1996,
    COALESCE(cu.n_cards, 0) AS n_cards,
    COALESCE(lu.n_loans, 0) AS n_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.loan_standing_label, 'no loan') AS loan_standing_label,
    COALESCE(t97.n_trans, 0) AS n_trans_1997,
    COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
    COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
    COALESCE(pb.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
    COALESCE(rb.balance_rank, (
        SELECT 1 + COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pb2.peak_balance,0))
        FROM tabor_accounts ta2
        LEFT JOIN peak_balances pb2 ON ta2.account_id = pb2.account_id
        WHERE COALESCE(pb2.peak_balance,0) > 0
    )) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM tabor_accounts ta
LEFT JOIN owners o ON ta.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards_up_to_1996 cu ON ta.account_id = cu.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_up_to_1996 lu ON ta.account_id = lu.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_standing ls ON ta.account_id = ls.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_1997 t97 ON ta.account_id = t97.account_id
LEFT JOIN peak_balances pb ON ta.account_id = pb.account_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_balances rb ON ta.account_id = rb.account_id
ORDER BY rb.balance_rank ASC, ta.account_id ASC;

        JOIN client_account_district cad ON t.account_id = cad.account_id
        WHERE t.type = 'debit' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.date,
    r.time AS utc_time,
    c.circuitId,
    c.circuitRef,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location,
    c.country
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
winner_result AS (
  SELECT
    ri.*,
    res.driverId,
    res.positionOrder,
    res.milliseconds AS total_ms
  FROM race_info ri
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = ri.raceId
  WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
driver_info AS (
  SELECT
    wr.*,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url
  FROM winner_result wr
  JOIN drivers d ON wr.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT
  forename,
  surname,
  url,
  -- Compute local time of finish in Baku (UTC+4). Preference is given to raceinfo.time (RACE UTC time),
  -- then add race duration (milliseconds) to it and convert to Baku local.
  -- There may be nulls for race.time; if so, ignore time calculation.
  CASE
    WHEN utc_time IS NOT NULL AND total_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Convert race UTC time to seconds, add race duration, then convert to local Baku time (UTC+4).
      time(
        datetime(
          utc_time,                           -- race start utc time (hh:mm:ss)
          printf('+%.3f seconds', total_ms / 1000.0),  -- add race duration
          '+4 hours'                          -- convert to Baku local time (UTC+4)
        )
      ) || '.' || printf('%03d', total_ms % 1000)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS finish_local_time_baku
FROM driver_info
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND d.forename IN (
      SELECT forename
      FROM drivers
      GROUP BY forename
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) > 1
  )
  AND (
    -- All time columns are for Q1, possible formats: "m:ss.sss", "m:ss", etc.
    -- Qualifying times may be null; times faster than 2 minutes ("2:00.000")
    -- Lower = faster, so need times less than "2:00.000"
    -- SQLite compares string times as text; pad single digit mins to 2 digits
    -- Handle both "m:ss.sss" and null strings, ignore malformed entries
    (
      LENGTH(q.q1) >= 5
      AND (
        -- If time in format "m:ss.xxx", split minute and second
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 +
        CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
      ) < 120
    )
  )
;

WITH french_gp_races AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 1990
      AND (LOWER(name) = 'french grand prix' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%france%')
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        MIN(
          (lt.milliseconds / 1000)
        ) AS fastest_lap_seconds
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN french_gp_races r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId, d.driverId
),
slower_than_90s AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.date,
        dfl.forename,
        dfl.surname,
        dfl.fastest_lap_seconds
    FROM french_gp_races r
    LEFT JOIN driver_fastest_laps dfl
      ON r.raceId = dfl.raceId AND dfl.fastest_lap_seconds > 90
)
SELECT
    s.date,
    s.forename,
    s.surname,
    CASE
        WHEN s.fastest_lap_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN
            printf('%d:%06.3f',
                   CAST(s.fastest_lap_seconds/60 AS INTEGER),
                   s.fastest_lap_seconds - 60 * CAST(s.fastest_lap_seconds/60 AS INTEGER)
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fastest_lap_mssmmm
FROM slower_than_90s s
ORDER BY
    s.date ASC,
    CASE WHEN s.surname IS NULL THEN '' ELSE s.surname END ASC,
    CASE WHEN s.fastest_lap_seconds IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE s.fastest_lap_seconds END ASC,
    CASE WHEN s.forename IS NULL THEN '' ELSE s.forename END ASC
;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  LIMIT 1
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.constructorId,
    q.q2,
    q.raceId
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 igp ON q.raceId = igp.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q2 ASC, q3 ASC NULLS LAST) as q2_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      q.driverId,
      q.constructorId,
      q.q2,
      -- Find grid position from results
      (SELECT grid FROM results WHERE raceId = q.raceId AND driverId = q.driverId) as grid,
      -- Use q3 as secondary ordering; qualifying order is used in tie-breaker in F1
      q.q3
    FROM q2_times q
  ) sub
  ORDER BY q2 ASC, grid ASC
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM ranked_q2 rq
JOIN drivers d ON rq.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON rq.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE rq.q2_rank = 2
LIMIT 1;

WITH chinese_gp_2000s AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.year,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    r.name,
    r.circuitId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND LOWER(r.name) LIKE '%chinese%'
),
with_local_times AS (
  SELECT
    cgp.*,
    c.location,
    c.country,
    strftime('%H:%M', datetime(coalesce(cgp.date, '') || 'T' || coalesce(cgp.time, '00:00'), 'utc', 
      CASE
        -- China Standard Time, UTC+8
        WHEN c.country = 'China' THEN '+8 hours'
        ELSE '+0 hours'
      END)) AS local_start_time
  FROM chinese_gp_2000s cgp
  JOIN circuits c ON cgp.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
earliest_local_time AS (
  SELECT 
    *
  FROM with_local_times
  WHERE local_start_time = (
      SELECT MAX(local_start_time)
      FROM with_local_times
      WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start_time) FROM with_local_times
      )
  ) -- If tied earliest time, return the most recent one (MAX by year)
    AND year = (
      SELECT MAX(year) FROM with_local_times
      WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start_time) FROM with_local_times
      )
    )
),
race_to_analyze AS (
  SELECT raceId, year FROM earliest_local_time
),
runner_up_gap AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r2.positionOrder as runner_up_position,
    r2.driverId as runner_up_driverId,
    r2.time as runner_up_time_raw,
    r1.time as winner_time_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN r2.time IS NOT NULL AND r2.time LIKE '+%' THEN r2.time
      WHEN r2.time IS NOT NULL AND r1.time IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- Both times exist, and stored as canonical times -- calculate gap if possible
        ( 
          -- times are strings, may contain "+X.XXXs"
          -- Fallback: just output runner-up's "time" string  
          r2.time
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS runner_up_time_gap
  FROM results r1
  JOIN results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId AND r1.positionOrder = 1 AND r2.positionOrder = 2
  WHERE r1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_to_analyze)
)
SELECT 
  rta.year AS season_year,
  rug.runner_up_time_gap AS runner_up_gap_to_winner
FROM race_to_analyze rta
JOIN runner_up_gap rug ON rta.raceId = rug.raceId;

WITH race_times AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    c.circuitRef,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    -- Combine date and time to a full timestamp assuming UTC (as F1 schedules are commonly tracked in UTC)
    CASE
      WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN datetime(r.date || 'T' || r.time)
      ELSE datetime(r.date)
    END AS start_ts
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
)
, times_summary AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_ts) AS earliest_start,
    MAX(start_ts) AS latest_start
  FROM race_times
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS timing,
  circuitRef,
  earliest_start AS reference_start_time,
  NULL AS gap_seconds
FROM race_times, times_summary
WHERE start_ts = earliest_start

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'latest' AS timing,
  circuitRef,
  latest_start AS reference_start_time,
  CAST(strftime('%s', latest_start) - strftime('%s', earliest_start) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
FROM race_times, times_summary
WHERE start_ts = latest_start
;

WITH college_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.department
  FROM major m
  WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'

  FROM college_depts d

  JOIN member mb ON mj.major = mb.major

  JOIN major mj ON d.department = mj.department AND d.major = mj.major

  GROUP BY d.department, mj.major

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mj.major) AS department_majors,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mwm.major IS NOT NULL THEN mj.major END) AS member_held_majors,

FROM dept_majors d

LEFT JOIN majors_with_members mwm ON mj.major = mwm.major
JOIN members_per_major mpm ON d.department = mpm.department AND mj.major = mpm.major

WITH ece_major_college AS (
  SELECT college
  FROM major
  WHERE name = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering'
  LIMIT 1
),
departments_in_college AS (
  SELECT name AS department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = (SELECT college FROM ece_major_college)
),
event_participants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.major
  FROM member m
  JOIN event e ON m.member_id = e.member_id
),
dues_per_department AS (
  SELECT mj.name AS department, COALESCE(SUM(m.dues), 0) AS total_dues
  FROM departments_in_college dc
  LEFT JOIN major mj ON mj.name = dc.department
  LEFT JOIN member m ON m.major = mj.name
  LEFT JOIN event_participants ep ON ep.member_id = m.member_id
  WHERE ep.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mj.name
)
SELECT department, total_dues
FROM dues_per_department
ORDER BY department;

WITH expenses_over_50 AS (
  SELECT
    e.id AS expense_id,
    e.member_id,
    e.budget_id
  FROM expense e
  WHERE e.amount > 50

  LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.budget_id = b.id
  GROUP BY b.id, b.amount
),

)

  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,

FROM member_budget_remaining mbr
JOIN member m ON m.id = mbr.member_id
GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_budget_remaining DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC

WITH overbudget_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
    JOIN expense ex ON b.event_id = ex.event_id AND b.category = ex.category
    WHERE (b.amount - ex.amount) < 0
),
relevant_expenses AS (
    SELECT ex.expense_id, ex.description
    FROM expense ex
    WHERE ex.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM overbudget_events)
),
kinds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(kind)) AS kind
    FROM relevant_expenses, 
         LATERAL (
             SELECT value AS kind
             FROM (
                 SELECT regexp_replace(description, '[.,]', '', 'g') AS cleaned_desc
                 FROM (SELECT description FROM relevant_expenses)
             ),
             json_each('["' || REPLACE(cleaned_desc, ' ', '","') || '"]')
         )
    WHERE kind <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) 
FROM kinds;

WITH attended_events AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.name
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id
),

    e.event_id,

            THEN ex.amount
            ELSE 0

  FROM event e

  GROUP BY e.event_id
),

  SELECT event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS attendees

)

  ae.name AS event_name,

    WHEN ac.attendees > 0 THEN COALESCE(wp.water_expense, 0.0) / ac.attendees
    ELSE 0.0
  END, 2) AS amount_spent_per_attendee
FROM attended_events ae
LEFT JOIN water_expense_per_event wp ON ae.event_id = wp.event_id
LEFT JOIN attendee_count ac ON ae.event_id = ac.event_id
ORDER BY ae.name, ae.event_id

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

answer:
```sql
WITH PatientsOver55 AS (
    SELECT patient_id, gender
    FROM Patient
    WHERE DATE('2026-10-09') - DATE(date_of_birth) > 55 * 365.25
),
PatientsWithAbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id, p.gender
    FROM PatientsOver55 p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id
    WHERE l.test_name = 'PT' AND l.abnormal_flag = 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS percent_female
FROM PatientsWithAbnormalPT;
```

WITH abnormal_anti_ssa_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.PatientID = l.PatientID
  WHERE l.TestName = 'anti-SSA'
    AND (
      (l.AbnormalFlag = 1)
      OR (l.ResultValue IS NOT NULL AND l.ReferenceHigh IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.ResultValue AS FLOAT) > CAST(l.ReferenceHigh AS FLOAT))
      OR (l.ResultValue IS NOT NULL AND l.ReferenceLow IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.ResultValue AS FLOAT) < CAST(l.ReferenceLow AS FLOAT))
    )
    AND p.VisitType = 'outpatient'
)
, anti_rnp_titers AS (
  SELECT l.PatientID, MAX(CAST(l.ResultValue AS FLOAT)) AS max_anti_RNP_titer
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.TestName = 'anti-RNP'
    AND l.PatientID IN (SELECT PatientID FROM abnormal_anti_ssa_patients)
    AND l.ResultValue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY l.PatientID
)
, max_value AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_anti_RNP_titer) AS highest_titer

WITH exact_overlap_patients AS (
    SELECT p.patient_id
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN (
        SELECT patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT disease_name, '|') AS diseases
        FROM Examination
        WHERE diagnosis_status = '확진' -- assuming '확진' is 'diagnosed'
        GROUP BY patient_id
    ) ediseases ON ediseases.patient_id = p.patient_id
    WHERE (
        ediseases.diseases = 'rheumatoid arthritis|Sjögren''s syndrome'
        OR ediseases.diseases = 'Sjögren''s syndrome|rheumatoid arthritis'
        OR ediseases.diseases = 'rheumatoid arthritis' 
        OR ediseases.diseases = 'Sjögren''s syndrome'
    )
      AND (
        -- We want exactly these two diseases, so their combined set must match these names (in any order)
        (
            INSTR(ediseases.diseases, 'rheumatoid arthritis') > 0
            AND INSTR(ediseases.diseases, 'Sjögren''s syndrome') > 0
            AND LENGTH(REPLACE(REPLACE(ediseases.diseases, 'rheumatoid arthritis', ''), 'Sjögren''s syndrome', '')) = 1 -- Only one delimiter '|'
        )
    )
    -- Make sure NO other diagnosis except these two
),
lab_with_platelet_results AS (
    SELECT l.patient_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.lab_item = 'platelet' AND l.lab_result_normal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_normal_platelet
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM exact_overlap_patients)
    GROUP BY l.patient_id
),
patients_with_labs AS (
    SELECT patient_id FROM lab_with_platelet_results
),
patients_with_no_labs AS (
    SELECT patient_id FROM exact_overlap_patients
    WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_labs)
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.had_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_had_normal_platelet,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exact_overlap_patients) 
      - SUM(CASE WHEN l.had_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_never_had_normal_platelet
FROM lab_with_platelet_results l
UNION ALL
SELECT
    0 AS num_had_normal_platelet,
    COUNT(*) AS num_never_had_normal_platelet
FROM patients_with_no_labs
;

WITH LDH_labs AS (
    SELECT
        Laboratory.Patient_ID,
        Laboratory.Visit_ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.Test_Name = 'LDH'
      AND CAST(Laboratory.Result_Value AS FLOAT) > 600
      AND CAST(Laboratory.Result_Value AS FLOAT) < 800
),
Proteinuria_labs AS (
    SELECT
        Laboratory.Patient_ID,
        Laboratory.Visit_ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.Test_Name = 'Urine protein'
      AND (
        -- Result like "at least 300"
        (LOWER(Laboratory.Result_Value) LIKE 'at least %'
            AND CAST(trim(REPLACE(LOWER(Laboratory.Result_Value), 'at least', '')) AS FLOAT) >= 300)
        -- OR plain number
        OR (Laboratory.Result_Value GLOB '[0-9]*'
            AND CAST(Laboratory.Result_Value AS FLOAT) >= 300)
      )
),
Qualifying_visits AS (
    SELECT
        LDH_labs.Patient_ID,
        LDH_labs.Visit_ID
    FROM LDH_labs
    INNER JOIN Proteinuria_labs
      ON LDH_labs.Patient_ID = Proteinuria_labs.Patient_ID
     AND LDH_labs.Visit_ID = Proteinuria_labs.Visit_ID
),
Single_lab_visit_patients AS (
    SELECT
        q.Patient_ID
    FROM Qualifying_visits q
    GROUP BY q.Patient_ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q.Visit_ID) = 1
)

WITH creatinine_outlier_patients AS (

WITH T_CHO_labs AS (

    Laboratory.Patient_id,

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'

      FROM Patient p2

  FROM sle_patients sp
  INNER JOIN high_proteinuria_patients hpp ON sp.patient_id = hpp.patient_id
),
care_setting_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.patient_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.care_setting = 'Inpatient' THEN 'Hospitalized'
      WHEN e.care_setting = 'Outpatient' THEN 'Outpatient'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS main_care_setting
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM target_patients)
)
SELECT
  main_care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM care_setting_counts
WHERE main_care_setting IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY main_care_setting;

WITH severe_anemia_patients AS (

WITH eligible_patients AS (
  -- Identify patients born after 1980-01-01
  SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.BirthDate > '1980-01-01'
),
abnormal_fibrinogen AS (
  -- Find patients with at least one abnormal fibrinogen result
  SELECT DISTINCT e.PatientID
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ExamID = l.ExamID
  WHERE l.TestName = 'Fibrinogen'
    AND (CAST(l.ResultValue AS REAL) < 150 OR CAST(l.ResultValue AS REAL) > 450)
),
severe_proteinuria AS (
  -- Find patients with at least one severe proteinuria result
  -- Assuming TestName = 'Protein', units mg/dl, or dipstick value 3+ (300 mg/dl) or 4+ (>=1000 mg/dl)
  SELECT DISTINCT e.PatientID
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ExamID = l.ExamID
  WHERE l.TestName = 'Protein'
    AND (
      -- By numerical result
      (l.ResultUnit = 'mg/dl' AND CAST(l.ResultValue AS REAL) >= 300)
      OR
      -- By semi-quantitative dipstick coding: '3+' or '4+'
      (l.ResultUnit = 'dipstick' AND (l.ResultValue = '3+' OR l.ResultValue = '4+'))
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PatientID) AS EligiblePatientCount
FROM eligible_patients p
WHERE p.PatientID IN (
  SELECT PatientID FROM abnormal_fibrinogen
  UNION
  SELECT PatientID FROM severe_proteinuria
)
;

sql:
WITH Inpatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Admission = '+'
),
AntiDNATests AS (
  SELECT
    l.LaboratoryID,
    l.PatientID,
    l.TestDate,
    l.ItemName,
    l.ResultValue,
    l.ResultUnit
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ItemName LIKE '%anti-DNA%'
),
FilteredTests AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    CAST(a.ResultValue AS FLOAT) AS NumericResult
  FROM AntiDNATests a
  WHERE a.PatientID IN (SELECT PatientID FROM Inpatients)
    AND a.ResultValue IS NOT NULL
),
MaxResult AS (
  SELECT
    ft.PatientID,
    ft.LaboratoryID,
    ft.TestDate,
    ft.ItemName,
    ft.ResultValue,
    ft.ResultUnit
  FROM FilteredTests ft
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      PatientID,
      MAX(NumericResult) AS MaxResult
    FROM FilteredTests
    GROUP BY PatientID
  ) maxes
    ON ft.PatientID = maxes.PatientID AND ft.NumericResult = maxes.MaxResult
),
TopTest AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    p.BirthDate,
    p.Diagnosis
  FROM MaxResult m
  JOIN Patient p ON m.PatientID = p.PatientID
  ORDER BY m.NumericResult DESC, m.TestDate ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  TopTest.LaboratoryID,
  TopTest.PatientID,
  TopTest.TestDate,
  TopTest.ItemName,
  TopTest.ResultValue,
  TopTest.ResultUnit,
  CAST((julianday(TopTest.TestDate)-julianday(TopTest.BirthDate))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AgeAtTest,
  TopTest.Diagnosis
FROM TopTest;

WITH EligiblePatients AS (

    p.Patient_ID,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to Hospital'
      WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at Outpatient Clinic'

  FROM Patient p

FROM EligiblePatients ep
