WITH latest_IgG AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.care_setting,
    l.value AS igg_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.id = l.patient_id AND l.test_name = 'IgG'
),
setting_totals AS (
  SELECT
    care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_patients
  FROM Patient
  WHERE care_setting IN ('admitted to the hospital', 'followed at the outpatient clinic')
  GROUP BY care_setting
),
setting_normal AS (
  SELECT
    li.care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT li.patient_id) AS normal_patients
  FROM latest_IgG li
  WHERE li.rn = 1
    AND li.care_setting IN ('admitted to the hospital', 'followed at the outpatient clinic')
    AND li.igg_value IS NOT NULL
    AND li.igg_value BETWEEN 700 AND 1600 -- assuming normal range is 700-1600 mg/dL, adjust as needed
  GROUP BY li.care_setting
)
SELECT
  st.care_setting AS "care setting",
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(sn.normal_patients,0) / st.total_patients, 1) AS "percent with normal IgG at most recent check"
FROM setting_totals st
LEFT JOIN setting_normal sn ON st.care_setting = sn.care_setting
ORDER BY st.care_setting;

WITH qualifying_exams AS (
  SELECT
    Examination.examination_id,
    Examination.patient_id,
    Examination.diagnosed_diseases,
    Examination.symptom,
    Examination.examination_date,
    Patient.birth_date,
    Patient.patient_id as pat_id, -- to distinguish in tie-break

  FROM Examination
  JOIN Patient ON Examination.patient_id = Patient.patient_id
  WHERE

),
youngest_patients AS (

  ORDER BY birth_date DESC

youngest_ids AS (

    pat_id
  FROM qualifying_exams
  WHERE birth_date = (SELECT birth_date FROM youngest_patients)
  ORDER BY pat_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_exam AS (
  -- Among qualifying exams for youngest patient, get the most recent
  SELECT
    examination_id,
    symptom,
    overall_diagnosis
  FROM qualifying_exams
  WHERE pat_id = (SELECT pat_id FROM youngest_ids)
  ORDER BY examination_date DESC, examination_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  symptom,
  overall_diagnosis
FROM most_recent_exam;

WITH FirstVisit AS (
  SELECT 
    Patient.patient_id,
    Patient.birth_date,
    Examination.visit_date,
    Examination.diagnosis,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.patient_id ORDER BY Examination.visit_date ASC, Examination.examination_id ASC) AS rn

  WHERE date(Examination.visit_date) BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
),
TargetPatients AS (
  SELECT 
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    visit_date,
    diagnosis
  FROM FirstVisit
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT diagnosis
FROM TargetPatients
ORDER BY 
  -- Age at first visit, descending: older is greater difference between visit and birth
  julianday(visit_date) - julianday(birth_date) DESC, 
  patient_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH alt_tests AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.Patient_ID,
    MAX(Laboratory.Result_Value) AS max_alt
  FROM
    Laboratory
  WHERE
    Laboratory.Test_Name = 'ALT'
  GROUP BY
    Laboratory.Patient_ID
),
patients_within_normal AS (
  SELECT
    p.Patient_ID,
    p.Sex
  FROM
    Patient p
    LEFT JOIN alt_tests a ON p.Patient_ID = a.Patient_ID
  WHERE

    AND p.Sex IN ('male', 'female')
)

  Sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM
  patients_within_normal
GROUP BY
  Sex
ORDER BY
  Sex;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  HAVING MIN(type) = '-' AND MAX(type) = '-'
),
molecule_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN sbm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'all_single_bond' ELSE 'other' END AS group_type,
    m.label
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN single_bond_molecules sbm ON m.id = sbm.molecule_id
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT
    group_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM molecule_groups
  GROUP BY group_type
)
SELECT
  group_type,
  carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS difference
FROM group_counts

WITH mol_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.carcinogenicity,
    COUNT(a.id) AS atom_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM
    molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
  GROUP BY
    m.id, m.carcinogenicity
),
mol_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM
    molecule m
    LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.id = b.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
    LEFT JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
  GROUP BY
    m.id
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY b.carbon_touching_bonds DESC, a.atom_count DESC, a.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  a.molecule_id,
  a.carcinogenicity,
  a.atom_count,
  b.bond_count,
  a.carbon_atoms,
  a.chlorine_atoms,
  b.carbon_touching_bonds,
  b.multiple_bonds
FROM
  mol_atoms a
  LEFT JOIN mol_bonds b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE
  a.carbon_atoms > 0
ORDER BY
  rank
;
